title: Two holding a garment
discussedAt: Not discussed in Derech Tevunos; labelled from stock phrases for the nested-rail study
about: Bava Metzia 2a–3a — `שנים אוחזין`: the opening sugya of the tractate.

Four challenges to the mishnah in turn (the double clause, Ben Nannas, Sumchos, R. Yose), each answered under itself; Rav Pappa's answer to the first reaches back over the whole exchange it settles. Frames inside threads, and the one page in the corpus where opening a band puts a second rail in a second lane.
hint: Where to look: at **26** R. Yose’s challenge arrives open over four earlier challenges, each with its answers folded and Rav Pappa’s and Sumchos’ frames intact. Click the Sumchos band (*7 sentences folded · between …*) and a second rail appears one lane inside the mishnah’s — the only way a nested rail ever does. Open Rav Pappa’s band too and attention moves there: its rail takes the inner lane and Sumchos’, no longer enclosing it, drops out.

units.speaker: Mishnah
units.short: Mishnah: two hold a garment, each says I found…
units.he: שנים אוחזין בטלית… ויחלוקו
units.en: Mishnah: two hold a garment, each says I found it, each says it is all mine

units.short: Why teach both 'I found it' and 'it is all…
units.he: למה לי למתנא… ליתני חדא!
units.en: Why teach both 'I found it' and 'it is all mine'?

units.short: It teaches one case: I found it and it is all…
units.he: חדא קתני
units.en: It teaches one case: I found it and it is all mine

units.short: Then teach only 'I found it'
units.he: וליתני אני מצאתיה ואנא ידענא דכולה שלי
units.en: Then teach only 'I found it'

units.short: 'Found' alone could mean 'saw'; 'all mine'…
units.he: אי תנא אני מצאתיה הוה אמינא ראיתיה
units.en: 'Found' alone could mean 'saw'; 'all mine' rules that out

units.short: But Rabbanai: 'found' in Scripture means it…
units.he: והא אמר רבנאי ומצאתה דאתאי לידיה משמע
units.en: But Rabbanai: 'found' in Scripture means it came to hand

units.short: The tanna uses everyday speech, where seeing…
units.he: תנא לישנא דעלמא נקט
units.en: The tanna uses everyday speech, where seeing is called finding

units.short: Then teach only 'all mine'
units.he: וליתני כולה שלי ולא בעי אני מצאתיה
units.en: Then teach only 'all mine'

units.short: The extra clause teaches that seeing does not…
units.he: ממשנה יתירה אשמעינן דראיה לא קני
units.en: The extra clause teaches that seeing does not acquire

units.short: How can it be one case? It says 'this one… and…
units.he: ומי מצית אמרת חדא קתני? והא זה וזה קתני
units.en: How can it be one case? It says 'this one… and this one' twice

units.speaker: Rav Pappa
units.short: Rav Pappa: the first clause is a find, the…
units.he: אמר רב פפא: רישא במציאה וסיפא במקח וממכר
units.en: Rav Pappa: the first clause is a find, the second a purchase

units.short: And both are needed: a find alone, or a sale…
units.he: וצריכא
units.en: And both are needed: a find alone, or a sale alone, would not teach the other

units.short: A sale? See whose money the seller took
units.he: מקח וממכר, ולחזי זוזי ממאן נקט?
units.en: A sale? See whose money the seller took

units.short: He took from both, one willingly, one not, and…
units.he: לא צריכא דנקט מתרוייהו
units.en: He took from both, one willingly, one not, and cannot say which

units.short: Is the mishnah not Ben Nannas, who forbids…
units.he: לימא מתניתין דלא כבן ננס
units.en: Is the mishnah not Ben Nannas, who forbids oaths that make one side swear falsely?

units.short: Even Ben Nannas: here both may have lifted it…
units.he: אפילו תימא בן ננס
units.en: Even Ben Nannas: here both may have lifted it together, so no false oath is certain

units.short: Is the mishnah not Sumchos, who divides…
units.he: לימא מתניתין דלא כסומכוס
units.en: Is the mishnah not Sumchos, who divides doubtful money without an oath?

units.short: Then whose — the rabbis? They say the claimant…
units.he: ואלא מאי, רבנן? הא אמרי המוציא מחברו עליו הראיה!
units.en: Then whose — the rabbis? They say the claimant must prove

units.short: No: for the rabbis, both holding it is…
units.he: האי מאי? אי אמרת בשלמא רבנן
units.en: No: for the rabbis, both holding it is different from neither holding it

units.short: But for Sumchos, all the more should they…
units.he: אלא אי אמרת סומכוס… לא כל שכן!
units.en: But for Sumchos, all the more should they divide without an oath

move.marker: אלא אי אמרת … לא כל שכן!

units.short: Even Sumchos: he spoke of two uncertain…
units.he: אפילו תימא סומכוס: כי אמר סומכוס שמא ושמא
units.en: Even Sumchos: he spoke of two uncertain claims, not two certain ones

units.short: But Rabbah bar Rav Huna has Sumchos say it…
units.he: ולרבה בר רב הונא דאמר אמר סומכוס אפילו ברי וברי
units.en: But Rabbah bar Rav Huna has Sumchos say it even for certain claims

units.short: Even Sumchos: he spoke where there is a prior…
units.he: אפילו תימא סומכוס: היכא דאיכא דררא דממונא
units.en: Even Sumchos: he spoke where there is a prior monetary link

units.short: Is it not a fortiori? Here, with no link, all…
units.he: ולאו קל וחומר הוא?
units.en: Is it not a fortiori? Here, with no link, all the more divide without an oath

units.short: Even Sumchos: this oath is rabbinic, as R.…
units.he: אפילו תימא סומכוס: שבועה זו מדרבנן היא כדרבי יוחנן
units.en: Even Sumchos: this oath is rabbinic, as R. Yoḥanan said, against seizing another's cloak

units.short: Is the mishnah not R. Yose, who leaves…
units.he: לימא מתניתין דלא כרבי יוסי
units.en: Is the mishnah not R. Yose, who leaves disputed money until Elijah comes?

units.short: Then the rabbis? They too leave the remainder…
units.he: אלא מאי רבנן… הא נמי כשאר דמי!
units.en: Then the rabbis? They too leave the remainder until Elijah

units.short: No: for the rabbis, there one coin certainly…
units.he: האי מאי? אי אמרת בשלמא רבנן
units.en: No: for the rabbis, there one coin certainly belongs to one party; here both may own it

units.short: But for R. Yose, all the more should it wait…
units.he: אלא אי אמרת רבי יוסי היא… לא כל שכן!
units.en: But for R. Yose, all the more should it wait for Elijah

move.marker: אלא אי אמרת … לא כל שכן!

units.short: Even R. Yose: there a cheat is certain, here…
units.he: אפילו תימא רבי יוסי: התם ודאי איכא רמאי
units.en: Even R. Yose: there a cheat is certain, here perhaps both lifted it

units.short: Or: there R. Yose penalises the cheat to make…
units.he: אי נמי: התם קניס ליה רבי יוסי לרמאי
units.en: Or: there R. Yose penalises the cheat to make him confess; here there is nothing to confess

units.short: That works for a find; what of a sale?
units.he: תינח מציאה, מקח וממכר מאי איכא למימר?
units.en: That works for a find; what of a sale?

units.short: Rather, the first answer is the clear one
units.he: אלא מחוורתא כדשנין מעיקרא
units.en: Rather, the first answer is the clear one

units.short: For rabbis and R. Yose alike: the shopkeeper's…
units.he: בין לרבנן ובין לרבי יוסי, התם גבי חנוני על פנקסו
units.en: For rabbis and R. Yose alike: the shopkeeper's ledger — both swear and collect, though a cheat is certain

units.short: There the shopkeeper and the worker each have…
units.he: אמרי: התם היינו טעמא
units.en: There the shopkeeper and the worker each have a claim on the employer alone

units.short: And the worker likewise, so both swear and…
units.he: ושכיר נמי אמר ליה
units.en: And the worker likewise, so both swear and collect from the employer
